notes.title: Summer 2022 Update
notes.notes:
Added additional weapon type for planes. It allows you to bomb crash sites without need for tactical mission. Of course at cost of lost equipment and soldiers experience.
Integrated x-Mod (thanks Tywiggins and Csilk for contribution)
Reintroduced some of old Bman mod settings
Improved mission GUI
Bugfixes


Thanks for all bug reports and improvement suggestions.
Chaos Concept

notes.title: Update Notes December 31
notes.notes:
In this update we have finally fixed mouse related problems. It also adds support for next/prev mouse buttons e.g. switch to next/previous unit in mission or inventory screens. Last but not least you could run game in borderless window, so you don't have to worry about fullscreen modes any more.

Happy New Year and Thanks for all bug repports and improvement suggestions.
Chaos Concept
